title: Gas rooms, exhausted enclosures and gas cabinets.
officialText:
The ventilation system for gas rooms, exhausted enclosures and gas
cabinets for any quantity of hazardous material shall be designed to operate at a negative pressure in relation to the surrou nding area.
Highly toxic and toxic gases shall also comply with Sections 502.9.7.1, 502.9.7.2 and 502.9.8.4.
